title: DXF viewer parser lineage and projection boundary
mode: Primary-source open-source viewer and parser dependency research
scope: Screen a newer open-source DXF viewer for genuinely independent parser lineage and useful projection evidence.
Refresh the existing vagran/dxf-viewer route and compare declared renderer scope and evidence limits.
Refine PAR-07/S8 and PAR-14 without adding routine peer builds, persistent fixtures, or support claims.

sources.revision: Mutable main README and notices inspected 2026-10-20; no commit hash, release artifact, or runtime was pinned or run.
sources.observed: The project declares a DXF-only, read-only viewer with no CAD kernel. It lists rendered 2D entities and transformations; states HATCH is not parsed by its dxf crate, fit-point-only splines are approximated, MLINE is centerline-only, and unsupported types are counted; and documents separate hostile-input budgets plus generated fixtures and tests that do not require a GPU.
sources.limits: The third-party notice lists the Rust dxf crate. Its published 0.6.1 manifest identifies https://github.com/ixmilia/dxf-rs as the crate repository, so this app is not an independent parser lineage from IxMilia. Its custom reader/encoding path means the precise delegation boundary must be inspected if ever run. Viewer output cannot establish DWG, ACIS/AcDs, 3D CAD semantics, exact DXF field preservation, or native application acceptance.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: permit at most one pinned 2D viewer only for an unresolved composed-checkpoint projection question; separate viewer parser lineage from its scene/render implementation.

PAR-07/S8: use fixed-view, predeclared projection observables for only the selected viewer's supported entity subset; report unsupported/ignored counts and avoid pixel-perfect comparisons across tessellation/font stacks.
PAR-14: re-use existing hostile-input controls and audit amplification dimensions independently; do not infer safety from a single aggregate output count or peer benchmark.

planChanges: Added opendxfviewer to the comparator map as a renderer route that reuses the IxMilia dxf crate lineage, not as an independent parser.
Refined vagran/dxf-viewer as a dxf-parser-based 2D projection route with explicit feature/encoding/OCS/layout limitations and no semantic-oracle role.

Specified a conditional, single-viewer composed checkpoint with pinned revision/runtime, predeclared supported subset, fixed-view observables, explicit unsupported counts, and NOT_RUN/NOT_APPLICABLE handling.
Kept current fast-slice cadence and local generated/eligible-fixture policy; no viewer build, test, dependency, fixture, or support claim was introduced.
limitations: Repository, README, notices, and package manifest are mutable or published snapshots; exact source and runtime artifacts must be pinned before any future execution.
No peer executable/package, native CAD application, GPU renderer, external drawing, or fixture corpus was run or downloaded.
Viewer output is projected display evidence only and cannot establish exact DXF syntax/field retention, document graph preservation, DWG decoding, ACIS/AcDs semantics, or native acceptance.
ODA v5.4.1 and Autodesk DXF references remain authoritative for their respective format-layout questions; viewer behavior is not normative.
